name: Encoding
citation: HL7 v2.3 Chapter 2 sec 2.8.13 ED - encapsulated data, HL7 Table 0299 - Encoding

entries.description: no encoding - data are displayable ASCII characters.
hexadecimal encoding - consecutive pairs of hexadecimal digits represent consecutive single octets.
encoding as defined by MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions)
